summary: The reader has finished an undergraduate computer science degree: asymptotic analysis, basic algorithm design (divide and conquer, recurrences), discrete mathematics (sets, subsets, binary representation, modular arithmetic, primes, gcd), and linear algebra (vector spaces, subspaces, matrices, rank, orthogonal projection, invertible matrices). They have met complex numbers, polynomials and basic Turing machines, but not the fast-multiplication literature, Fourier analysis beyond basics, or advanced algebra and coding theory.

known.name: Recurrence relations and the master theorem
known.gloss: Running time of a recursive algorithm is bounded by solving a recurrence such as T(n)=aT(n/b)+f(n).

known.name: Binary representation of integers
known.gloss: A nonnegative integer is written as a string of bits, each weighted by a power of two.

known.name: Modular arithmetic
known.gloss: Arithmetic on integers taken modulo m, where numbers differing by a multiple of m are identified.

known.name: Chinese remainder theorem
known.gloss: For pairwise coprime moduli, a residue modulo their product corresponds uniquely to a tuple of residues modulo each modulus.

known.name: Prime numbers, gcd and Euclidean algorithm
known.gloss: Primes, greatest common divisors, coprimality and the computation of gcds and modular inverses by the Euclidean algorithm.

known.name: Vector spaces, subspaces and linear maps
known.gloss: Standard linear algebra over a field, including bases, dimension, subspaces and orthogonal complements.

known.name: Matrices, rank and invertibility
known.gloss: Matrices represent linear maps; rank is the dimension of the image, and invertible matrices have inverses.

known.name: Gaussian elimination
known.gloss: Reducing a matrix to simpler form with elementary row operations, used to find rank and solve linear systems.

known.name: Sets, subsets, functions and permutations
known.gloss: Basic discrete mathematics of finite sets, subsets, maps, bijections and permutations.

known.name: Floor, ceiling, logarithms and rounding
known.gloss: Standard integer-rounding functions and base-2 logarithms used in size and cost estimates.

known.name: Roots of unity
known.gloss: Complex numbers z with z^n=1, which form a cyclic group under multiplication.

known.name: Cyclic groups and products of groups
known.gloss: The group of integers modulo n under addition, and direct products of such groups indexed by tuples.

known.name: Multidimensional arrays and mixed-radix indexing
known.gloss: Arrays with several indices stored in a linear order by mixed-radix address.

known.name: Basic probability and counting bounds
known.gloss: Elementary counting and averaging arguments used to show that some choice meets a bound.

known.name: Norms, error bounds and triangle inequality
known.gloss: Bounding the size of vectors and numerical errors by norms and the triangle inequality.

known.name: Fixed-point and finite precision arithmetic
known.gloss: Representing numbers with a fixed number of binary digits and the error that truncation introduces.

known.name: Integer addition, multiplication and carry propagation
known.gloss: Grade-school algorithms for adding and multiplying integers, with addition taking linear time on a tape.

known.name: Sorting and linear tape scans
known.gloss: Sorting and linear passes over data, with merge sort costing O(n log n) comparisons.

known.name: Constants, asymptotic functions and polylog factors
known.gloss: Asymptotic notation beyond big-O, such as Theta and Omega, and polylogarithmic growth.

known.name: XOR and bitwise operations
known.gloss: Bitwise exclusive-or, which is addition of bits modulo 2.
